antibiotics
The first time I took x was with my boyfriend. We both took 100 mgs each. While he rolled extreamly hard I was left irritated and uncomfortable because I had no feelings of being under the influence of anything. I have done a lot more psychoactives than him but so have some of many of my friends that took the same pill and still rolled very hard. I had taken a maxafed(an antibiotic) earlier that day. Some of my friends said that that was most likely the reason I had no side effects from the x.
